title: Thermodynamic modulation of Tau liquid-liquid phase separation and condensate wetting by two-dimensional nanomaterial interfaces: emergent suppression via adsorption equilibrium (simulation code and data)
description:
Statistical-thermodynamic, Cahn-Hilliard interfacial-gradient, and chemical master-equation code supporting the manuscript of the same name.

The repository contains a calibrated Flory-Huggins-Voorn-Overbeek engine for the Tau K18 lower critical solution temperature, a Langmuir interfacial adsorption mass balance, a fully dimensionalised Cahn-Hilliard wetting / Young contact-angle solver, mass-conserving condensate-aging master equations, and a Saltelli-Jansen Sobol global sensitivity analysis (N_base = 1024, 10240 physical model evaluations). A single script (run_pipeline.py) reproduces the unit-test suite, all five master figures (300 dpi PNG, vector PDF, 600 dpi TIFF), the RSC table-of-contents graphic, the master manuscript and cover letter, and the distribution archive. Continuous integration runs the test suite on Linux and Windows for Python 3.10-3.12.
